Dune Armchair

Category Furniture
Brand Frighetto
Collection Frighetto
Year 2007

The Dune armchair for the famous Italian publishing house Frighetto takes on an architectural dimension with its lines, curves and colorful hollow joints and offers traditional comfort, while creating soft lines with slight roundings, which make it more statutory.
